title: Tier and matrix changes never reprice parts already on a work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier B for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a special-order part (Source: Vendor) not yet received on line 1, category A, cost $100.00, priced at $121.50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Type 30 in the bulk bar's value.
  5. Click Set Rule.
  6. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  7. Open work order 1.
  8. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  9. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  10. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  11. Pick tier B.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Open work order 1.
  14. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  15. Click Change Customer.
  16. Pick customer B.
  17. Click Update Customer.
  18. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The bulk bar shows the count 1.

Step 4:

  • % Off is picked with the value 30.

Step 5:

  • The Set Rule question opens.

Step 6:

  • Matrix A's row reads 30% off.

Step 7:

  • The part still reads $121.50.
  • A new price would have been $94.50 ($135.00 × 0.70 = $94.50).

Step 8:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 9:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 10:

  • The picker lists tier B.

Step 11:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier B.

Step 12:

  • Customer A is saved on tier B.

Step 13:

  • The part still reads $121.50.

Step 14:

  • The menu lists Change Customer, Split Work Order and Back to Work Orders.

Step 15:

  • The Change Customer dialog opens.

Step 16:

  • Customer B is picked.

Step 17:

  • Work order 1 names customer B.

Step 18:

  • The part still reads $121.50 after the reload.
  • Its Priced by still names tier A.
